objective: Provide structured intelligence regarding commonly encountered concealment methods in narcotics investigations to support evidence identification, investigative analysis and machine learning feature interpretation.

concealment_patterns.description: Hidden compartments incorporated into luggage or baggage for concealing narcotic substances.
Modified compartments within vehicles identified during enforcement operations.
Commercial courier consignments intercepted during enforcement or customs inspections.
Commercial food packages identified during seizure operations.
Personal care or cosmetic containers examined during baggage or parcel inspections.
Concealment within garments or personal belongings identified during lawful searches.

investigation_guidelines: Photograph concealed evidence before recovery whenever practicable.
Document the concealment location in detail.
Maintain chain of custody throughout recovery.
Collect fingerprints or DNA where appropriate.
Record concealment method for intelligence analysis.
references: United Nations Office on Drugs and Crime (UNODC) World Drug Report
